blocks.zh: §4.5–4.9：RFD 申請流程、PMOA 判定與主管中心指定
blocks.en: §4.5–4.9: RFD Application Process, PMOA Determination and Lead Center Assignment

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標 Learning Objectives
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 說明取得主管中心指定的三條路徑（非正式 OCP 諮詢、Pre-RFD 會議、正式 RFD），並能判斷何種情況應選哪條路（§4.5 + §3.4）
blocks.en: Explain the three routes to obtaining a lead center assignment (informal OCP consultation, Pre-RFD meeting, formal RFD) and decide which route fits which situation (§4.5 + §3.4)

blocks.zh: 列出正式 RFD 申請所需的七項內容要素（§3.7(a)），並理解 FDA 60 天回覆時鐘對申請人的法律意義
blocks.en: List the seven content elements required in a formal RFD (§3.7(a)) and understand the legal significance of FDA's 60-day response clock for the requester

blocks.zh: 運用三步驟 PMOA 分析框架，對藥物塗層氣球、預填充式注射器、細胞療法支架等典型產品進行 PMOA 判定與主管中心指配（§3.7(b) + §4.3）
blocks.en: Apply the three-step PMOA analysis framework to determine the PMOA and assign the lead center for typical products such as drug-coated balloons, prefilled syringes and cell-therapy scaffolds (§3.7(b) + §4.3)

blocks.zh: 解釋主管中心（Lead Center）與諮詢中心（Consulting Center）的角色分工，以及中心指定如何直接觸發 CGMP 義務（§4.9/§3.9）
blocks.en: Explain the division of roles between the Lead Center and the Consulting Center, and how center assignment directly triggers CGMP obligations (§4.9/§3.9)

blocks.zh: 描述 RFD 爭議解決機制，以及 CDMO 在承接組合產品製造合約前必須確認的中心指定狀態
blocks.en: Describe the RFD dispute resolution mechanism, and the center assignment status a CDMO must confirm before accepting a combination product manufacturing contract

blocks.zh: 2.1 §4.5 + §3.4 — How Do You Know Which Center Regulates?（如何確認主管中心）
blocks.en: 2.1 §4.5 + §3.4 — How Do You Know Which Center Regulates?

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：海關進口分類的邏輯
blocks.en: Analogy: The Logic of Customs Import Classification

blocks.zh: 想像你要將一件「含有電子控溫功能的特殊藥品保溫箱」進口到美國。海關要決定這究竟是「電子設備」（課 3% 關稅）還是「醫療器材」（免稅）還是「藥品輔助包裝」（另一套規定）。
blocks.en: Imagine you want to import a "special pharmaceutical storage box with electronic temperature control" into the United States. Customs has to decide whether it is "electronic equipment" (3% duty), a "medical device" (duty-free) or "drug auxiliary packaging" (governed by yet another set of rules).

blocks.zh: 你有三條路：
blocks.en: You have three routes:

blocks.zh: 非正式諮詢：打電話問海關官員，他說「我覺得應該是醫療器材」——但這不算正式裁定，明天換一個官員可能答案不同
blocks.en: Informal consultation: You call a customs officer, who says, "I think it should be a medical device." But this is not a formal ruling, and a different officer tomorrow might give a different answer.

blocks.zh: 預申請會議：請海關主管開個會，討論分類依據，確認你的申請文件方向是對的
blocks.en: Pre-application meeting: You ask a customs supervisor for a meeting to discuss the classification basis and confirm that the direction of your application documents is right.

blocks.zh: 正式申請裁定：提交完整說明文件，海關 60 天內給出正式書面裁定——這才是你可以依賴的法律基礎
blocks.en: Formal ruling request: You submit a complete package, and customs issues a formal written ruling within 60 days. This is the legal basis you can actually rely on.

blocks.zh: RFD 流程就是這個邏輯：FDA 決定你的「組合產品」落在哪個監管桶子裡，並用正式書面讓你知道。
blocks.en: The RFD process follows the same logic: FDA decides which regulatory "bucket" your combination product falls into, and tells you in a formal written document.

blocks.zh: 三條路徑的選擇邏輯
blocks.en: Choosing Among the Three Routes

blocks.zh: 實務上，大多數有經驗的 RA 團隊會採取「遞進式」策略：
blocks.en: In practice, most experienced RA teams take a "step-up" approach:

blocks.zh: 先做非正式諮詢，了解 OCP 的初步觀點
blocks.en: Start with an informal consultation to learn OCP's preliminary view

blocks.zh: 若有疑義，申請 Pre-RFD 會議釐清文件準備方向
blocks.en: If questions remain, request a Pre-RFD meeting to clarify how to prepare the documentation

blocks.zh: 最後正式提交 RFD，取得有法律效力的指定
blocks.en: Finally, submit a formal RFD to obtain a legally binding designation

blocks.zh: 重要原則：正式 RFD 一旦取得，在整個產品生命週期中都有約束力——除非產品的 constituent parts 或 intended use 有重大變更。
blocks.en: Key principle: once a formal RFD designation is obtained, it is binding throughout the product lifecycle, unless there is a significant change to the product's constituent parts or intended use.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：何時一定要提 RFD
blocks.en: Key Point: When an RFD Is a Must

blocks.zh: 以下情況強烈建議提交正式 RFD，不能只依賴非正式諮詢：
blocks.en: A formal RFD is strongly recommended in the following situations; informal consultation alone is not enough:

blocks.zh: 組合產品的藥品與器材作用幾乎「旗鼓相當」，難以判斷 PMOA
blocks.en: The drug and device contributions of the combination product are nearly "evenly matched," making the PMOA hard to judge

blocks.zh: 涉及 CBER 管轄（細胞治療、基因治療）——這類產品規範最複雜
blocks.en: CBER jurisdiction is involved (cell therapy, gene therapy); these products have the most complex regulatory requirements

blocks.zh: CDMO 承接合約製造前，需要書面證據確認適用 CGMP 範疇
blocks.en: A CDMO needs written evidence of the applicable CGMP scope before accepting a contract manufacturing assignment

blocks.zh: 公司計畫在多個市場同步申請，需要 FDA 指定作為其他監管機構的參考
blocks.en: The company plans to file in multiple markets at the same time and needs the FDA designation as a reference for other regulators

blocks.zh: 2.2 §3.7 — Request for Designation (RFD)（正式指定申請）
blocks.en: 2.2 §3.7 — Request for Designation (RFD)

blocks.zh: RFD 的本質：監管身份的「出生證明」
blocks.en: The Essence of an RFD: A "Birth Certificate" for Regulatory Identity

blocks.zh: RFD 就像是向 FDA 申請確認你的產品的「監管身份」。一旦取得指定：
blocks.en: An RFD is like asking FDA to confirm your product's "regulatory identity." Once the designation is obtained:

blocks.zh: 主管中心確立 → 知道要向誰送 IND/NDA/BLA/PMA
blocks.en: The lead center is established: you know to whom to submit the IND/NDA/BLA/PMA

blocks.zh: 適用 CGMP 確立 → 知道工廠需要符合哪套規範
blocks.en: The applicable CGMP is established: you know which set of requirements the manufacturing site must meet

blocks.zh: 審查途徑確立 → 知道哪個審查部門的指引文件最相關
blocks.en: The review pathway is established: you know which review division's guidance documents are most relevant

blocks.zh: 這三件事在產品開發早期確立，可以避免後期因指定不明確而導致的昂貴重工或法規延誤。
blocks.en: Settling these three points early in development avoids costly rework and regulatory delays later caused by an unclear designation.

blocks.zh: 關鍵：60 天時鐘的雙向意義
blocks.en: Key Point: The 60-Day Clock Cuts Both Ways

blocks.zh: 60 天時鐘對雙方都有意義：
blocks.en: The 60-day clock has meaning for both sides:

blocks.zh: 對申請人： 提交完整 RFD 後，不必無限期等待——60 天後若 FDA 未回應，自動指定規則適用
blocks.en: For the requester: After a complete RFD is submitted, you do not have to wait indefinitely. If FDA has not responded after 60 days, the automatic designation rule applies.

blocks.zh: 對 FDA： 這是一個強制性回覆義務——確保 OCP 不能無限期拖延決策
blocks.en: For FDA: It is a mandatory response obligation, ensuring that OCP cannot delay its decision indefinitely.

blocks.zh: 常見誤區： 60 天是從 FDA 收到「完整」RFD 開始計算，不是從提交日計算。若 FDA 認為 RFD 資料不完整，可以發出「補件要求（Refuse to Review）」，時鐘會暫停。
blocks.en: Common misconception: The 60 days run from FDA's receipt of a "complete" RFD, not from the submission date. If FDA considers the RFD incomplete, it may issue a refuse-to-review notice and the clock stops.

blocks.zh: 因此，提交高品質、完整的 RFD 是讓 60 天時鐘準時開始運行的關鍵。
blocks.en: Submitting a high-quality, complete RFD is therefore the key to getting the 60-day clock started on time.

blocks.zh: RFD 的約束力範圍
blocks.en: Scope of an RFD's Binding Effect

blocks.zh: FDA 指定具有約束力，但有其邊界：
blocks.en: An FDA designation is binding, but it has limits:

blocks.zh: 約束的是：哪個 FDA 中心主導；哪套 CGMP 基線適用
blocks.en: What it binds: which FDA center takes the lead, and which CGMP baseline applies

blocks.zh: 不約束的是：具體的審查決定（核准 or 拒絕）；任何個別審查的技術結論
blocks.en: What it does not bind: the specific review decision (approval or rejection), or the technical conclusions of any individual review

blocks.zh: 可重新申請的條件：constituent parts 有重大變更；intended use 根本改變；新的科學證據顯示 PMOA 認定有誤
blocks.en: Grounds for re-filing: significant changes to the constituent parts; a fundamental change in intended use; new scientific evidence showing that the PMOA determination was wrong

blocks.zh: 2.3 §3.7(a) — Required RFD Content（RFD 必要內容要素）
blocks.en: 2.3 §3.7(a) — Required RFD Content

blocks.zh: 七項要素的實務重要性排序
blocks.en: Ranking the Seven Elements by Practical Importance

blocks.zh: 從 FDA 審查角度，七項要素的分量不均等：
blocks.en: From FDA's review perspective, the seven elements do not carry equal weight:

blocks.zh: 最關鍵（Element 3）： PMOA 的科學論證——這是 OCP 做決定的核心依據。論證越充分，FDA 越可能接受你提議的指定
blocks.en: Most critical (Element 3): The scientific rationale for the PMOA. This is the core basis for OCP's decision. The stronger the rationale, the more likely FDA is to accept your proposed designation.

blocks.zh: 高重要性（Element 1 + 2）： 產品描述與各成分的法規狀態——沒有這個，OCP 無法建立基礎認識
blocks.en: High importance (Elements 1 + 2): The product description and the regulatory status of each constituent part. Without these, OCP cannot build a basic understanding of the product.

blocks.zh: 中等重要性（Element 4 + 5）： 用途描述和製程說明——幫助 OCP 判斷哪個中心有最相關的審查能力
blocks.en: Medium importance (Elements 4 + 5): The description of intended use and the manufacturing process, which help OCP judge which center has the most relevant review expertise.

blocks.zh: 情境性要素（Element 6 + 7）： 包裝說明（只有共包裝產品需要）、先前互動（有的話必須揭露）
blocks.en: Situational elements (Elements 6 + 7): The packaging description (needed only for co-packaged products) and prior interactions (must be disclosed if any).

blocks.zh: Element 3 的品質決定一切
blocks.en: The Quality of Element 3 Decides Everything

blocks.zh: 幾乎所有 RFD 的成功或失敗，都取決於 Element 3 的說服力：
blocks.en: Almost every RFD succeeds or fails on the persuasiveness of Element 3:

blocks.zh: 需要引用已發表的科學文獻支持 PMOA 論點
blocks.en: Cite published scientific literature to support the PMOA argument

blocks.zh: 需要解釋為什麼其他作用模式不是 primary
blocks.en: Explain why the other modes of action are not primary

blocks.zh: 如果兩種 MOA 都很強，要預先討論 tie-breaker 分析（哪個中心有更多相關審查經驗）
blocks.en: If both MOAs are strong, address the tie-breaker analysis up front (which center has more relevant review experience)

blocks.zh: 非臨床與臨床數據（若有）都可以用來支持 PMOA 論點
blocks.en: Both nonclinical and clinical data (if available) can be used to support the PMOA argument

blocks.zh: 一份強而有力的 Element 3，可以讓 FDA 直接接受你的建議；一份薄弱的 Element 3，會讓 OCP 花時間重新分析，甚至推翻你的建議。
blocks.en: A strong Element 3 can lead FDA to accept your recommendation directly; a weak Element 3 makes OCP spend time re-analyzing and may even overturn your recommendation.

blocks.zh: 實作練習：RFD 要素配對
blocks.en: Exercise: Matching RFD Elements

blocks.zh: 對於一個「含有抗生素塗層的骨科固定板（orthopaedic fixation plate with antibiotic coating）」，試著為每個要素寫出關鍵內容點：
blocks.en: For an "orthopaedic fixation plate with antibiotic coating," try writing the key content points for each element:

blocks.zh: Element 1： 描述產品形態——鈦板（器材）+ 萬古黴素塗層（藥品）
blocks.en: Element 1: Describe the product form: titanium plate (device) + vancomycin coating (drug)

blocks.zh: Element 2： 鈦板：已有類似器材 510(k)；萬古黴素：已核准藥品 (ANDA)
blocks.en: Element 2: Titanium plate: similar devices already have 510(k)s; vancomycin: approved drug (ANDA)

blocks.zh: Element 3（關鍵）： 骨折固定是主要治療效果（機械支撐），抗生素防止感染是輔助效果 → 主張 PMOA = 機械（Device），Lead Center = CDRH
blocks.en: Element 3 (critical): Fracture fixation is the primary therapeutic effect (mechanical support), and infection prevention by the antibiotic is a secondary effect → propose PMOA = mechanical (Device), Lead Center = CDRH

blocks.zh: Element 4： 用途：骨折手術固定；患者族群：成人外傷病患；途徑：外科植入（implantation）
blocks.en: Element 4: Intended use: fixation in fracture surgery; patient population: adult trauma patients; route: surgical implantation

blocks.zh: Element 5： 製程：鈦板機加工 → 表面處理 → 萬古黴素浸塗 → 滅菌
blocks.en: Element 5: Process: titanium plate machining → surface treatment → vancomycin dip coating → sterilization

blocks.zh: Element 6： 非共包裝，此項 N/A（骨板與塗層是單一實體）
blocks.en: Element 6: Not co-packaged, so N/A (the bone plate and the coating are a single entity)

blocks.zh: Element 7： 曾參加 CDRH Pre-Sub 會議，CDRH 口頭確認傾向接受此產品
blocks.en: Element 7: Attended a CDRH Pre-Sub meeting, where CDRH verbally indicated it was inclined to accept this product

blocks.zh: 2.4 §3.7(b) + §4.3 — PMOA Determination（主要作用模式判定）
blocks.en: 2.4 §3.7(b) + §4.3 — PMOA Determination

blocks.zh: PMOA 定義精確解析
blocks.en: The PMOA Definition, Parsed Precisely

blocks.zh: FDA 對 PMOA 的定義有兩個核心要件，缺一不可：
blocks.en: FDA's definition of PMOA has two core requirements, and both must be met:

blocks.zh: 「Single」——PMOA 只有一個，不能說「有兩個 primary MOA」。這是監管邏輯的必要性：必須選出一個主管中心
blocks.en: "Single": There is only one PMOA; you cannot say there are "two primary MOAs." The regulatory logic requires this, because a single lead center must be selected.

blocks.zh: 「Most important therapeutic action」——衡量標準是「對整體預期治療效果的最大貢獻」，而不是「哪個 MOA 更複雜」或「哪個 constituent part 更貴」
blocks.en: "Most important therapeutic action": The yardstick is the "greatest contribution to the overall intended therapeutic effect," not "which MOA is more complex" or "which constituent part is more expensive."

blocks.zh: 常見錯誤：用「藥品佔成本的 80%」或「器材的技術門檻更高」來推論 PMOA——這些都不是正確的判斷標準。
blocks.en: Common mistake: inferring the PMOA from "the drug accounts for 80% of the cost" or "the device has the higher technical barrier." Neither is a correct criterion.

blocks.zh: PMOA 決策流程圖 (ASCII Flowchart)
blocks.en: PMOA Decision Flowchart (ASCII Flowchart)

blocks.zh:
STEP 1: 列出所有 MOA
   |
   v
[組合產品的每個 constituent part 各有哪些 MOA？]
Drug MOA(s): Pharmacological / Immunological / Metabolic
Device MOA(s): Mechanical / Physical
   |
   v
STEP 2: 哪個 MOA 對治療效果貢獻最大？
   |
   +--[答案清楚]---------------------------------> PMOA 確定
   |                                               |
   |                                               v
   |                                          PMOA = Pharmacological → CDER
   |                                          PMOA = Immunological   → CBER
   |                                          PMOA = Metabolic       → CBER
   |                                          PMOA = Mechanical      → CDRH
   |                                          PMOA = Physical        → CDRH/CDER
   |
   +--[兩種 MOA 科學上難以區分]--> STEP 3: TIE-BREAKER
                                         |
                                         v
                              哪個中心對主要安全有效性問題有最多專業？
                                         |
                              [仍不清楚] → 哪個中心有最多類似產品審查經驗？
                                         |
                                         v
                                    指定該中心為 Lead Center
blocks.en:
STEP 1: List all MOAs
   |
   v
[What MOA(s) does each constituent part of the combination product have?]
Drug MOA(s): Pharmacological / Immunological / Metabolic
Device MOA(s): Mechanical / Physical
   |
   v
STEP 2: Which MOA contributes most to the therapeutic effect?
   |
   +--[Answer is clear]---------------------------------> PMOA determined
   |                                               |
   |                                               v
   |                                          PMOA = Pharmacological → CDER
   |                                          PMOA = Immunological   → CBER
   |                                          PMOA = Metabolic       → CBER
   |                                          PMOA = Mechanical      → CDRH
   |                                          PMOA = Physical        → CDRH/CDER
   |
   +--[Two MOAs scientifically hard to distinguish]--> STEP 3: TIE-BREAKER
                                         |
                                         v
                              Which center has the most expertise in the main safety and effectiveness questions?
                                         |
                              [Still unclear] → Which center has the most experience reviewing similar products?
                                         |
                                         v
                                    Assign that center as Lead Center

blocks.zh: 四個案例的 PMOA 分析邏輯
blocks.en: PMOA Analysis Logic for Four Cases

blocks.zh:
1. 藥物塗層氣球（Drug-coated balloon）：
問：「如果沒有紫杉醇，只用氣球，還有治療效果嗎？」→ 答：有（機械擴張）
問：「如果沒有氣球，只用紫杉醇，還有治療效果嗎？」→ 答：不行（無法到達病灶）
結論：機械擴張是最重要的效果 → PMOA = Mechanical → CDRH
blocks.en:
1. Drug-coated balloon:
Q: "Without the paclitaxel, would the balloon alone still have a therapeutic effect?" → A: Yes (mechanical dilation)
Q: "Without the balloon, would paclitaxel alone still have a therapeutic effect?" → A: No (it cannot reach the lesion)
Conclusion: Mechanical dilation is the most important effect → PMOA = Mechanical → CDRH

blocks.zh:
2. 預填充式注射器（小分子藥品）：
問：「注射器換成普通注射器，藥品效果改變嗎？」→ 答：不改變
結論：藥品是治療核心，注射器只是遞送工具 → PMOA = Pharmacological → CDER
blocks.en:
2. Prefilled syringe (small-molecule drug):
Q: "If the syringe is replaced with an ordinary syringe, does the drug's effect change?" → A: No
Conclusion: The drug is the therapeutic core and the syringe is only a delivery tool → PMOA = Pharmacological → CDER

blocks.zh:
3. 細胞療法支架：
問：「支架的主要功能是什麼？」→ 答：提供細胞生長的三維結構支撐
問：「治療效果來自細胞還是支架？」→ 答：細胞（生物功能）
結論：生物細胞是治療核心 → PMOA = Immunological/Biological → CBER
blocks.en:
3. Cell-therapy scaffold:
Q: "What is the scaffold's main function?" → A: To provide three-dimensional structural support for cell growth
Q: "Does the therapeutic effect come from the cells or the scaffold?" → A: The cells (biological function)
Conclusion: The living cells are the therapeutic core → PMOA = Immunological/Biological → CBER

blocks.zh:
4. 光動力治療：
問：「光能殺腫瘤嗎（沒有藥物）？」→ 答：不能
問：「藥物沒有光能殺腫瘤嗎？」→ 答：不能
難點：兩者缺一不可——這是 tie-breaker 的典型情況
實務結論：光是啟動藥物的工具；主要安全問題集中在藥物毒性 → CDER 通常主導
blocks.en:
4. Photodynamic therapy:
Q: "Can the light kill the tumor (without the drug)?" → A: No
Q: "Can the drug kill the tumor without the light?" → A: No
Difficulty: Neither works without the other; this is a classic tie-breaker situation
Practical conclusion: The light is a tool for activating the drug, and the main safety concern is drug toxicity → CDER usually takes the lead

blocks.zh: Tie-Breaker 的實際意義
blocks.en: What the Tie-Breaker Means in Practice

blocks.zh: Tie-breaker 規則（§3.8/§4.8(b)）在實務上使用頻率不高，但理解它非常重要：
blocks.en: The tie-breaker rule (§3.8/§4.8(b)) is not used often in practice, but it is important to understand:

blocks.zh: 它依據的是「誰有最多相關審查能力」，而非主觀的「哪個更像藥品」
blocks.en: It is based on "who has the most relevant review expertise," not on a subjective sense of "which looks more like a drug"

blocks.zh: OCP 會考察：該中心過去審查過多少類似產品？該中心對此類安全問題的積累知識更豐富？
blocks.en: OCP will look at how many similar products the center has reviewed in the past, and whether the center has accumulated deeper knowledge of this type of safety issue

blocks.zh: 對申請人的意義：如果你的 PMOA 論點不夠強，OCP 會使用 tie-breaker——結果可能與你期待的不同。因此，強化 Element 3 的科學論證是最佳策略
blocks.en: What it means for the requester: if your PMOA argument is not strong enough, OCP will apply the tie-breaker, and the outcome may differ from what you expected. Strengthening the scientific rationale in Element 3 is therefore the best strategy.

blocks.zh: 2.5 §4.9 / §3.9 — Center Assignment & Consequences（中心指定與 CGMP 後果）
blocks.en: 2.5 §4.9 / §3.9 — Center Assignment & Consequences

blocks.zh: Lead Center vs. Consulting Center：角色分工精解
blocks.en: Lead Center vs. Consulting Center: The Division of Roles Explained

blocks.zh: 一個常見的誤解是：「我只需要管主管中心的要求，諮詢中心的要求可以忽略。」這是錯誤的。
blocks.en: A common misunderstanding is: "I only need to follow the lead center's requirements; the consulting center's requirements can be ignored." This is wrong.

blocks.zh: 正確理解：
blocks.en: The correct understanding:

blocks.zh: Lead Center = 主要溝通窗口 + 最終決策者，但不代表你只需符合它的 CGMP
blocks.en: Lead Center = the main communication contact and final decision-maker, but this does not mean you only need to comply with its CGMP

blocks.zh: Consulting Center = 它的意見是binding（有約束力的），Lead Center 必須認真考慮
blocks.en: Consulting Center = its input is binding, and the Lead Center must give it serious consideration

blocks.zh: 實務上，若 CDER leads 一個含有器材組成件的組合產品，CDRH 仍會對器材組成件的品質系統要求有發言權
blocks.en: In practice, if CDER leads a combination product that contains a device constituent part, CDRH still has a say in the quality system requirements for the device constituent part

blocks.zh: 這就是為什麼 §4.3 說明了雙重 CGMP 義務——不是 Lead Center 的 CGMP，而是各個 constituent part 適用的 CGMP。
blocks.en: This is why §4.3 sets out dual CGMP obligations: not the Lead Center's CGMP, but the CGMP applicable to each constituent part.

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務情境：簽合約前的中心指定確認
blocks.en: CDMO Scenario: Confirming the Center Assignment Before Signing the Contract

blocks.zh: 案例：客戶委託 CDMO 製造「藥物洗脫支架（Drug-eluting stent, DES）」。
blocks.en: Case: A client commissions a CDMO to manufacture a "drug-eluting stent (DES)."

blocks.zh: CDMO 在簽署製造服務合約（MSA）之前，必須確認：
blocks.en: Before signing the manufacturing services agreement (MSA), the CDMO must confirm:

blocks.zh: 中心指定狀態： 客戶是否已取得 OCP 正式 RFD 指定？（DES 通常由 CDRH 主導）
blocks.en: Center assignment status: Has the client obtained a formal RFD designation from OCP? (DES are usually led by CDRH)

blocks.zh: 適用 CGMP： CDRH leads → 21 CFR Part 820 (QMSR) 是主要 CGMP；21 CFR 210/211 適用於藥品成分（西羅莫司/紫杉醇塗層）
blocks.en: Applicable CGMP: CDRH leads → 21 CFR Part 820 (QMSR) is the primary CGMP; 21 CFR 210/211 apply to the drug component (sirolimus/paclitaxel coating)

blocks.zh: 品質協議分工： CDMO 負責哪個 constituent part 的 CGMP 合規？整個組合產品，還是只有器材組件？
blocks.en: Quality agreement allocation: Which constituent part's CGMP compliance is the CDMO responsible for? The whole combination product, or only the device component?

blocks.zh: 諮詢中心義務： CDER 作為諮詢中心對藥品塗層有要求——CDMO 的藥品製造設施是否符合 21 CFR 211？
blocks.en: Consulting center obligations: CDER, as consulting center, has requirements for the drug coating. Does the CDMO's drug manufacturing facility comply with 21 CFR 211?

blocks.zh: 若 CDMO 在未確認上述資訊的情況下簽約，可能面臨：合規範疇估算錯誤 → 投入超出預算的合規成本；FDA 查廠時因系統不符合適用 CGMP 而收到 483 觀察項目。
blocks.en: If the CDMO signs without confirming the above, it may face: a misjudged compliance scope → compliance costs exceeding budget; and Form FDA 483 observations during an FDA inspection because its systems do not meet the applicable CGMP.

blocks.zh: 中心指定如何觸發 CGMP 義務（§4.3 連結）
blocks.en: How Center Assignment Triggers CGMP Obligations (Link to §4.3)

blocks.zh: 這是 Section 1（§4.3）與 Section 2（RFD 流程）的關鍵連接點：
blocks.en: This is the key connection between Section 1 (§4.3) and Section 2 (the RFD process):

blocks.zh: 換言之：你不能在取得中心指定之前確定工廠需要建立哪些 CGMP 系統。這就是 CDMO 在簽合約前必須知道 RFD 狀態的核心原因。
blocks.en: In other words, you cannot determine which CGMP systems the manufacturing site needs to establish before the center assignment is obtained. This is the core reason a CDMO must know the RFD status before signing a contract.

blocks.zh: 2.6 RFD Timeline & Dispute Resolution（RFD 時程與爭議解決）
blocks.en: 2.6 RFD Timeline & Dispute Resolution

blocks.zh: RFD 時程的實務意義
blocks.en: The Practical Meaning of the RFD Timeline

blocks.zh: 從產品開發整體時間線來看，RFD 60 天是相對快速的：
blocks.en: Within the overall product development timeline, the 60-day RFD is relatively quick:

blocks.zh: 相比一個完整 PMA 審查（180 天 + 通常延長），60 天的確定性是「便宜」的
blocks.en: Compared with a full PMA review (180 days, usually extended), the certainty of 60 days is "cheap"

blocks.zh: 但 60 天要能有效利用，前提是在提交 RFD 時已有充分的 PMOA 科學數據
blocks.en: But to use the 60 days effectively, you need sufficient scientific data supporting the PMOA at the time of RFD submission

blocks.zh: 太早提交（沒有支持 PMOA 的數據）→ OCP 可能要求補件 → 時鐘停止 → 反而拖延
blocks.en: Submitting too early (no data supporting the PMOA) → OCP may request additional information → the clock stops → it ends up causing delay

blocks.zh: 太晚提交（已接近上市申請）→ 若中心指定結果出乎預料，可能需要重新調整整個申請策略
blocks.en: Submitting too late (already close to the marketing application) → if the center assignment comes out unexpectedly, the entire application strategy may need to be readjusted

blocks.zh: 建議時機：完成概念驗證（PoC）研究後、進入 Phase 1/First-in-Human 前。
blocks.en: Recommended timing: after proof-of-concept (PoC) studies are complete and before entering Phase 1/First-in-Human.

blocks.zh: 爭議解決的關鍵時間點
blocks.en: Key Time Points in Dispute Resolution

blocks.zh: 三個關鍵時間點，錯過任一個都會失去特定救濟途徑：
blocks.en: There are three key time points, and missing any one of them forfeits a specific avenue of relief:

blocks.zh: 15 天： 提出重新考量要求（Reconsideration Request）的截止日——收到指定後 15 天
blocks.en: 15 days: Deadline for filing a Request for Reconsideration, counted from receipt of the designation

blocks.zh: 15 天： OCP 回覆重新考量要求的期限
blocks.en: 15 days: Deadline for OCP to respond to the reconsideration request

blocks.zh: 30 天： 向 Office of the Commissioner 上訴的截止日——收到 OCP 重新考量決定後 30 天
blocks.en: 30 days: Deadline for appealing to the Office of the Commissioner, counted from receipt of OCP's reconsideration decision

blocks.zh: 實務提示：在等待爭議解決期間，原始指定仍然有效。這意味著你不能以「正在爭議中」為由暫停合規工作。建議同步推進：既爭議，也準備符合原始指定的開發工作。
blocks.en: Practical tip: while the dispute is pending, the original designation remains in effect. This means you cannot suspend compliance work on the grounds that "the matter is in dispute." Advance on both fronts: pursue the dispute and also carry out development work consistent with the original designation.

blocks.zh: 綜合練習：四個 PMOA 分類練習
blocks.en: Comprehensive Exercise: Four PMOA Classification Exercises

blocks.zh: 對以下四個產品，判斷 PMOA 類別與建議的 Lead Center：
blocks.en: For each of the following four products, determine the PMOA category and the recommended Lead Center:

blocks.zh:
含 heparin 塗層的血管導管（Heparin-coated vascular catheter）
藥品 MOA：Heparin 抗凝血（藥理作用）
器材 MOA：導管進入靜脈、提供靜脈通路（機械作用）
問：主要治療目的是什麼——靜脈通路還是抗凝血？
分析：靜脈通路是主要臨床目的，heparin 塗層是防止導管相關血栓的輔助設計 → PMOA = 機械 → CDRH
blocks.en:
Heparin-coated vascular catheter
Drug MOA: Heparin anticoagulation (pharmacological action)
Device MOA: The catheter enters the vein and provides venous access (mechanical action)
Q: What is the primary therapeutic purpose, venous access or anticoagulation?
Analysis: Venous access is the primary clinical purpose, and the heparin coating is a secondary design feature to prevent catheter-related thrombosis → PMOA = mechanical → CDRH

blocks.zh:
胰島素自動注射筆（Insulin auto-injector pen）
藥品 MOA：胰島素降血糖（藥理作用，主要）
器材 MOA：自動注射機構（機械，遞送工具）
分析：換一種注射方式不影響胰島素效果；注射筆只是遞送工具 → PMOA = 藥理 → CDER
blocks.en:
Insulin auto-injector pen
Drug MOA: Insulin lowers blood glucose (pharmacological action, primary)
Device MOA: Automatic injection mechanism (mechanical, delivery tool)
Analysis: Changing the injection method does not affect the effect of insulin; the pen is only a delivery tool → PMOA = pharmacological → CDER

blocks.zh:
含生長因子的骨骼組織修復基質（Growth factor-eluting bone matrix）
藥品/生物 MOA：BMP-2（骨形態蛋白）刺激骨再生（生物作用）
器材 MOA：骨基質提供結構支撐和骨傳導（機械作用）
問：如果沒有 BMP-2，骨基質能刺激新骨形成嗎？→ 只有骨傳導，不能主動刺激骨再生
分析：BMP-2 的生物作用是最重要的治療效果 → PMOA = 生物/代謝 → CBER
blocks.en:
Growth factor-eluting bone matrix
Drug/biologic MOA: BMP-2 (bone morphogenetic protein) stimulates bone regeneration (biological action)
Device MOA: The bone matrix provides structural support and osteoconduction (mechanical action)
Q: Without BMP-2, could the bone matrix stimulate new bone formation? → Only osteoconduction; it cannot actively stimulate bone regeneration
Analysis: The biological action of BMP-2 is the most important therapeutic effect → PMOA = biological/metabolic → CBER

blocks.zh:
含顯影劑的可吸收縫線（Contrast agent-impregnated absorbable suture）
藥品 MOA：顯影劑（iodine）讓縫線在影像下可見（放射顯影作用，輔助）
器材 MOA：縫線固定組織傷口（機械作用，主要）
分析：治療目的是傷口固定；顯影功能只是輔助診斷工具 → PMOA = 機械 → CDRH
blocks.en:
Contrast agent-impregnated absorbable suture
Drug MOA: The contrast agent (iodine) makes the suture visible under imaging (radiographic action, secondary)
Device MOA: The suture closes the tissue wound (mechanical action, primary)
Analysis: The therapeutic purpose is wound closure; the imaging function is only an auxiliary diagnostic aid → PMOA = mechanical → CDRH

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務情境：承接藥物洗脫支架製造前的確認清單
blocks.en: CDMO Scenario: Confirmation Checklist Before Taking On Drug-Eluting Stent Manufacturing

blocks.zh: 情境設定： 一家 CDMO 的業務部門接到一張詢價單——客戶希望將藥物洗脫支架（DES，含西羅莫司塗層的冠狀動脈支架）的製造委外給 CDMO。業務主管詢問：「這跟我們現有的器材製造能力差不多，可以直接簽合約嗎？」
blocks.en: Scenario: A CDMO's sales department receives a request for quotation. The client wants to outsource manufacturing of a drug-eluting stent (DES, a coronary stent with a sirolimus coating) to the CDMO. The sales manager asks: "This is similar to our existing device manufacturing capability. Can we just sign the contract?"

blocks.zh: 答案是：不能直接簽。必須先確認以下五件事：
blocks.en: The answer is: no, not directly. Five things must be confirmed first:

blocks.zh:
確認 RFD 指定狀態
要求客戶提供 OCP 正式指定文件。若尚未取得 RFD，CDMO 需了解客戶計畫何時提交，並在合約中設定「取得 RFD 後方可啟動製造」的先決條件。
為什麼：沒有正式指定，CDMO 無法確定主管中心和適用的 CGMP 範疇。
blocks.en:
Confirm the RFD designation status
Ask the client to provide the formal OCP designation document. If no RFD has been obtained yet, the CDMO needs to learn when the client plans to submit it, and should set a precondition in the contract that "manufacturing may start only after the RFD is obtained."
Why: Without a formal designation, the CDMO cannot determine the lead center or the applicable CGMP scope.

blocks.zh:
確認 Lead Center 與 CGMP 義務矩陣
DES 的 PMOA 通常為「機械（Mechanical）」→ Lead Center = CDRH → 主要 CGMP = 21 CFR Part 820 (QMSR)。但西羅莫司塗層屬藥品成分 → 21 CFR Parts 210/211 同時適用於藥品 constituent part 的製造。
CDMO 需確認：工廠是否同時持有符合 Part 820 的 QMS 和符合 Part 211 的藥品製造能力？還是只有其中之一？
blocks.en:
Confirm the Lead Center and the CGMP obligation matrix
The PMOA of a DES is usually "Mechanical" → Lead Center = CDRH → primary CGMP = 21 CFR Part 820 (QMSR). But the sirolimus coating is a drug component → 21 CFR Parts 210/211 also apply to the manufacture of the drug constituent part.
The CDMO needs to confirm: does the site hold both a QMS that meets Part 820 and drug manufacturing capability that meets Part 211? Or only one of the two?

blocks.zh:
確認品質協議中的 CGMP 責任分配
若 CDMO 只負責器材組件（支架金屬骨架），西羅莫司塗層由另一家供應商提供，品質協議必須明確定義：誰對藥品 constituent part 的 Part 211 合規負責？
FDA 查廠時，會分別評估每個 constituent part 的 CGMP 合規——沒有明確分工可能導致 CDMO 被連帶要求負責其能力範圍之外的事項。
blocks.en:
Confirm the allocation of CGMP responsibilities in the quality agreement
If the CDMO is responsible only for the device component (the metal stent scaffold) and the sirolimus coating is supplied by another supplier, the quality agreement must clearly define: who is responsible for Part 211 compliance for the drug constituent part?
During an FDA inspection, CGMP compliance is assessed separately for each constituent part. Without a clear allocation, the CDMO may be held jointly responsible for matters outside its capability.

blocks.zh:
確認諮詢中心（Consulting Center）的特定要求
即使 CDRH 是 Lead Center，CDER 作為 Consulting Center 仍會對西羅莫司塗層的配方、穩定性、和劑量均一性提出要求。CDMO 需了解這些 CDER 要求是否已反映在客戶的 IND/NDA 計畫中，以及是否有任何尚未解決的 CDER 意見可能影響製造規格。
blocks.en:
Confirm the specific requirements of the Consulting Center
Even if CDRH is the Lead Center, CDER, as Consulting Center, will still set requirements for the sirolimus coating's formulation, stability and dose uniformity. The CDMO needs to know whether these CDER requirements are already reflected in the client's IND/NDA plan, and whether any unresolved CDER comments could affect the manufacturing specifications.

blocks.zh:
確認 CDMO 設施是否列入客戶的 FDA 提交文件
若 CDMO 的場地尚未在客戶的 PMA（Premarket Approval）或 IDE（Investigational Device Exemption）申請中登錄，任何製造變更都需要 PMA Supplement 或 IDE 修訂。CDMO 需在合約中明確規定：製造場地的 FDA 登錄由哪一方負責，以及場地新增的監管費用歸屬。
blocks.en:
Confirm whether the CDMO facility is listed in the client's FDA submissions
If the CDMO's site has not yet been registered in the client's PMA (Premarket Approval) or IDE (Investigational Device Exemption) application, any manufacturing change will require a PMA Supplement or an IDE amendment. The CDMO should specify in the contract which party is responsible for registering the manufacturing site with FDA, and who bears the regulatory fees for adding the site.

blocks.zh: 結論： DES 是典型的「雙重 CGMP 義務」產品。CDMO 若未在合約前完成上述確認，輕則導致合規成本超支，重則在 FDA 查廠中因 CGMP 系統不符合適用要求而收到 Warning Letter，連帶影響客戶的上市許可。這五項確認是 CDMO 組合產品業務的最基本盡職調查（Due Diligence）。
blocks.en: Conclusion: A DES is a typical product with "dual CGMP obligations." If the CDMO does not complete the above confirmations before the contract, the best case is compliance cost overruns; the worst case is a Warning Letter in an FDA inspection because the CGMP systems do not meet the applicable requirements, which in turn affects the client's marketing authorization. These five confirmations are the most basic due diligence for a CDMO's combination product business.

blocks.zh: 本節摘要 Section 2 Summary
blocks.en: Section 2 Summary

blocks.zh: 中文核心摘要
blocks.en: Commentary

blocks.zh: 三條確認主管中心的路徑： 非正式 OCP 諮詢（最快但無約束力）→ Pre-RFD 會議（準備性）→ 正式 RFD（有法律效力，60 天強制回覆）
blocks.en: Three routes to confirm the lead center: informal OCP consultation (fastest but not binding) → Pre-RFD meeting (preparatory) → formal RFD (legally binding, mandatory 60-day response)

blocks.zh: RFD 七項必要內容： 其中 Element 3（PMOA 科學論證）最關鍵，直接決定 OCP 是否接受你建議的中心指定
blocks.en: Seven required RFD content elements: Element 3 (the scientific rationale for the PMOA) is the most critical and directly determines whether OCP accepts your proposed center assignment

blocks.zh: PMOA 三步驟： 列出所有 MOA → 判定哪個對治療效果貢獻最大 → 若不清楚，用 tie-breaker（哪個中心有最多相關審查能力）
blocks.en: Three steps for PMOA: list all MOAs → determine which contributes most to the therapeutic effect → if unclear, use the tie-breaker (which center has the most relevant review expertise)

blocks.zh: 中心指定直接觸發 CGMP 義務： 不是「主管中心用哪套 CGMP，你就用哪套」——而是「每個 constituent part 各自適用的 CGMP 都必須遵守」
blocks.en: Center assignment directly triggers CGMP obligations: it is not "whichever CGMP the lead center uses, you use" but rather "the CGMP applicable to each constituent part must be followed"

blocks.zh: CDMO 行動原則： 承接任何組合產品合約前，必須確認 RFD 指定狀態 + Lead Center + CGMP 義務矩陣 + 品質協議分工，這是最基本的盡職調查
blocks.en: CDMO action principle: before taking on any combination product contract, confirm the RFD designation status + Lead Center + CGMP obligation matrix + quality agreement allocation; this is the most basic due diligence

blocks.zh: 本節關鍵數字速記
blocks.en: Key Numbers at a Glance

blocks.zh: 60 天： FDA 回覆 RFD 的法定期限
blocks.en: 60 days: The statutory deadline for FDA to respond to an RFD

blocks.zh: 7 項： RFD 必要內容要素
blocks.en: 7 elements: Required RFD content elements

blocks.zh: 3 步驟： PMOA 判定分析框架
blocks.en: 3 steps: The PMOA determination analysis framework

blocks.zh: 5 類： Mode of Action 類別（藥理、免疫、代謝、機械、物理）
blocks.en: 5 categories: Mode of Action categories (pharmacological, immunological, metabolic, mechanical, physical)

blocks.zh: 15 天： 提出 Reconsideration 的截止日
blocks.en: 15 days: Deadline for filing a Reconsideration request

blocks.zh: 30 天： 向 Office of Commissioner 上訴的截止日
blocks.en: 30 days: Deadline for appealing to the Office of the Commissioner

blocks.zh: 3 個中心： CDER (药)、CDRH (器)、CBER (生物) — 每個都可能成為 Lead 或 Consulting Center
blocks.en: 3 centers: CDER (drugs), CDRH (devices), CBER (biologics); each may be either the Lead or the Consulting Center
